import Gallery from '../../components/gallery.astro';

![Database monitoring's in-product marketing](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/dbmon.zero.png?f=avif)

**Addressing the gap and expanding capabilities** Splunk Observability Cloud excelled at application and infrastructure monitoring but lacked the end-to-end insight that database monitoring would provide. That gap forced users to switch tools, even as public forum requests and AppDynamics' $50M ARR success showed clear demand. Launching database monitoring would close the application-database performance divide and unlock a new DBA persona, expanding Splunk Observability Cloud's TAM.

In parallel, Splunk acquired Replex—renamed Application Optimization—for Kubernetes workload tuning that improves application performance. Integrating it into Splunk Observability Cloud added another optimization layer alongside the new database vertical.

![Extending capabilities at the intersection of applications and infrastructure](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/problem.png?f=avif)

**Designing for scalability** I started by understanding the product roadmap, and researching the necessary user needs for database monitoring and application optimization. That was followed by laying the groundwork for an information architecture that can accommodate both the extensions as well as any future needs. Finally, becoming proficient with Splunk's design system and UI patterns was crucial to ensure consistency across the platform.

**Impact** Alpha launch of Database monitoring had 11 customer signups with a conversion rate of 64% within 3 months of launch. This number is currently estimated to grow to 25 by the end of Q1 2026.

### Information architecture

![Information architecture utilizing the action-oriented UI states](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/ia.png?f=avif)

### Visualizations and micro-interactions

The query explain plan was visualized using a tree structure to represent the various operations involved in executing a database query. Micro-interactions were obsessed over to ensure that the tree structure was intuitive and easy to navigate.

![Constructing composite components in Figma](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/constructing-components.png?f=avif)

![Various states of the query explain plan component](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/queryExecutionPlan.component.png?f=avif)

### Defining AI-assisted workflows

I defined and designed AI-assisted workflows such as query summarization, and AI-based recommendations to help users optimize their database queries. Both these features are currently in customer preview and are getting positive feedback.

![AI-assisted query summarization and recommendations](https://r2-image.raunaqgupta.workers.dev/dbmon-for-splunk-o11y-cloud/query.preview.ai-recommendations.png?f=avif)

<Recipe recipe="
>> servings: 1
>> time: 15 minutes

Roast 4 stalks of @asparagus{4%stalks} in a pan till suitably charred on all sides.

Mix 1/2 cup of @cottage cheese{1/2%cup} with @salt{}, @pepper{}, and a squeeze of @lemon{}.
Cut a @baguette{} into the same length as the asparagus stalks. Slice in half and lightly toast.
Butter both slices, and spread the cottage cheese spread on one side.
Place the asparagus stalks on top of the spread and firmly close the sandwich with the other slice.
